description: openSig application-dependency license gate (spec plan.md, Owner decision: platform license scope (resolved 2026-11-08); FR-011). Owner decision, verbatim: "MIT/Apache application and libraries; inventory platform licenses separately". Applies, with no waiver, to every shipped npm package (the production closure and its transitive dependencies) and every third-party asset copied into dist/. Non-shipped development tools are inventoried and reported, not gated. Pre-existing platforms (the Node runtime binary and its embedded components, the OS/base image, the browser, any JVM, test-time platform tools) are inventoried separately by scripts/platform-inventory.mjs with status INVENTORIED; they are not covered by this file and never affect this gate.
